workflowInfo.workflowDescription: Reports password expiry for all service IDs in a RACF group using IRRXUTIL

variable.name: RACF_GROUP
variable.label: RACF Group
variable.abstract: The RACF group whose members will be reported on
variable.description: All user IDs connected to this group will have their password interval and expiry date reported. Example: IZUADMIN

variable.name: WARN_DAYS
variable.label: Warning Threshold (days)
variable.abstract: Flag users whose password expires within this many days
variable.description: Any user ID whose password expires in fewer than this many days will be highlighted in the report output. Set to 0 to disable threshold warnings.

variable.name: REPORT_DATASET
variable.label: Report Output Dataset
variable.abstract: Optional dataset to write the report to (leave blank for SYSOUT only)
variable.description: If specified, the report will also be written to this sequential dataset. The dataset must already exist and be allocated. Leave blank to write to SYSOUT only.

step.name: listGroupMembers
step.title: List Group Members
step.description: Runs LISTGRP to confirm the target group exists and show its current member list
step.instructions: This step runs LISTGRP ${instance-RACF_GROUP} via IKJEFT01 to confirm the group exists and to record its current member list before the password report is generated.

step.name: generateReport
step.title: Generate Password Interval Report
step.description: Runs a REXX exec via IKJEFT01 that uses IRRXUTIL to extract password interval, last change date and expiry date for every member of the group

step.name: captureToDataset
step.title: Copy Report to Dataset (optional)
step.description: If REPORT_DATASET is specified, re-runs the report and routes SYSTSPRT to the named dataset for archival
step.instructions: Routes the same IKJEFT01 report to dataset ${instance-REPORT_DATASET} for archival or downstream processing. Only run this step if REPORT_DATASET has been specified.
